sources.roll: FL DOR 2026 Preliminary NAL (NAL16P202601.csv Broward co 16, NAL23P202601.csv Miami-Dade co 23), free download from floridarevenue.com data portal
sources.sales_broward: BCGIS hosted feature service PARCEL_POLY_BCPA_TAXROLL (SALE_DATE_1, doc-stamp-derived price, provenance: derived)
sources.sales_mdc: Miami-Dade gisweb MD_ComparableSales/MapServer/5 MDC.PaGis (DOS_1/PRICE_1, provenance: verified)

coverage_gaps: Broward condo-unit tenure: BCGIS PARCEL_POLY_BCPA_TAXROLL is a polygon layer; 87,650 of 102,175 Broward condo folios (letter-suffixed unit folios) have no polygon record, so last-sale/tenure is unknown for them (signal tenure_unknown_gis_unmatched, no tenure credit). SFR/multi/mobile matched 99.9-100%. Miami-Dade tenure coverage ~100% (MDC.PaGis).
NAL 2026P sale fields only carry 2025-26 assessment-period sales, so tenure had to come from county GIS layers, not the DOR roll.
BCPA's own bulk files (Tax Roll MS Access etc.) are paid commercial products ($25-30/file via InfoBroward); BCPA itself points to the free FL DOR portal, which was used instead.

566 parcels matched in GIS but with no recorded sale at all were treated as long-tenure (provenance: derived, signal no_recorded_sale_assumed_long_tenure); 19 of the top 30 rest on that assumption - typically pre-1970s acquisitions with deceased-owner EST names.
Broward last_sale_price is derived from doc stamps ($0.70/$100), provenance: derived. Miami-Dade PRICE_1 is as recorded (verified).
